text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 4: Day-ahead forecasts against measured power in three weeks chosen by rule'
text.tspan: Figure 4: Day-ahead forecasts against measured power in three weeks

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each row is one plant, and each group of six rows is one week. Power is a share of capacity. Black: measured power. Blue: B0's forecast of that power. Orange: L1's forecast of that power. The forecasts are out-of-fold: each is made by an XGBoost model that never trained on that month, with whole blocks of months (folds) held out in turn. The forecasts are at lead-day 1, for the day after the day of issue, from one of three training runs (fitting seeds). Weeks are chosen by rule, not by eye, from the weeks with data for all six plants: the sunniest (highest mean power across plants), the most variable between plants, and the cloudiest (lowest mean power). Arms. B0: the baseline with no lag. L1: B0 plus the power at the same hour on the latest whole day before the forecast was issued (two days before the target day for a day-ahead forecast).'
text.tspan: Each row is one plant, and each group of six rows is one week. Power is a share of capacity. Black: measured power.
